decision_router.title: Route harder requests with explicit control
decision_router.description: Compare configured model candidates, suggest a switch you can confirm, or apply an approved automatic escalation policy while keeping routing decisions visible.

usage_logger.title: See usage without saving prompts
usage_logger.description: Write one content-free JSONL record for each completed response, then let your harness read best-effort token totals for its verified session without exposing prompts or log contents.

tool_governor.title: Choose the tools your model sees
tool_governor.description: Restrict or replace model-visible tool definitions. Your harness can also request a reversible, user-confirmed allowance for a tool your allowlist omits; explicit denies always apply, and execution approval still belongs to the harness.

otel.title: Add request metrics
otel.description: Emit request shape, latency, observed status classes and provider-reported token usage through Torana's metrics host.

schema_translator.title: Adapt map-shaped tool schemas
schema_translator.description: Convert supported open-map tool parameters into key/value arrays for providers that need a constrained schema, then reverse the recorded conversion on streamed tool calls.

intent.title: Carry the reason for a tool call
intent.description: Ask the model to include why it is making a tool call, strip the added field before the harness sees the streamed call, and make captured intent available to a compactor.

keyword_compactor.title: Trim repeatable tool output without another model
keyword_compactor.description: Apply explicit deterministic or keyword policies to selected tool results. Useful for long searches and listings that can be rerun, while keeping source reads exact.

compactor.title: Summarize selected historical tool results
compactor.description: Use an operator-bound model for eligible older tool output, only when the estimated benefit clears the cache-rewrite and summarizer-cost gate. Your harness can inspect the active limits without triggering a model call.

pii.title: Check tool output with your local model
pii.description: Catch obvious sensitive values first, then use an operator-bound local model for contextual checks before tool output reaches the primary provider. Your harness can ask for value-free categories and line numbers from the latest protection.

pii_guard.title: Block recognizable sensitive values without a model
pii_guard.description: Use deterministic checks for recognizable PII and secret shapes. It needs no model or network destination, and your harness can ask why the latest tool result was protected without receiving the sensitive value.

cache_tier_selector.title: Choose a cache lifetime for a conversation
cache_tier_selector.description: Choose between configured prompt-cache tiers using observed idle gaps, while keeping a live cached prefix's choice stable.

cache_warmer.title: Keep one conversation's cache warm for a bounded gap
cache_warmer.description: Opt a conversation into periodic refresh requests, with a deadline and break-even budget. Useful only for explicit cache markers whose lifetime refreshes on a read.
